The evidence for including Marrku-Wurrugu in Iwaidjan is not sufficient as the
similarities may well be due to borrowing in the case of Marrku
**hh:vtyp:Evans:Marrku** and the very poorly attested Wurrugu was included
because of its lexical correspondences with Marrku rather than the rest of
Iwaidjan **hh:vw:Evans:Wurrugu**.
